name: Seasonal Toast (Spring)
instructions: 1. Toast bread to desired doneness. 2. Spread cottage cheese on toast. Warm cheese in microwave for 15 seconds if desired before spreading. 3. Place cucumber slices on top.

name: Seasonal Toast (Summer)
instructions: 1. Toast bread to desired doneness. 2. Spread cottage cheese on toast. Warm cheese in microwave for 15 seconds if desired before spreading. 3. Place blueberries or strawberries on top.

name: Seasonal Toast (Fall)
instructions: 1. Toast bread to desired doneness. 2. Spread cottage cheese on toast. Warm cheese in microwave for 15 seconds if desired before spreading. 3. Place sliced peaches on top.

name: Seasonal Toast (Winter)
instructions: 1. Toast bread to desired doneness. 2. Spread cottage cheese on toast. Warm cheese in microwave for 15 seconds if desired before spreading. 3. Place sliced pears on top.

name: Breakfast Sweet Potato
instructions: 1. Using a fork poke holes in sweet potato. 2. Microwave on high for 10 minutes or until soft. 3. Carefully cut sweet potato in half and scoop pulp into a bowl. 4. Mash sweet potato with a fork. Mix in yogurt syrup cinnamon and nuts. 5. Add any other desired toppings.

name: Microwave French Toast
instructions: 1. Crack egg into a microwave-safe mug. Add milk and cinnamon. 2. Whisk together until blended. 3. Dip bread in egg mixture coating both sides. 4. Place bread in mug and microwave for 60-90 seconds until set. 5. Top with maple syrup.

name: Microwave Veggie Stratta
ingredients: whole wheat bread,egg,skim milk,bell pepper,spinach,shredded cheese,salt,pepper
instructions: 1. Spray microwave-safe bowl with nonstick spray. 2. Add diced peppers and spinach. 3. Crack eggs into bowl and add milk salt and pepper. Whisk. 4. Tear bread into pieces and add to bowl. 5. Top with shredded cheese. 6. Microwave for 2-3 minutes until eggs are set.

name: Blueberry Banana Oats
instructions: 1. Prepare oats according to package directions. 2. Slice banana and add to oats along with blueberries. 3. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon. 4. Stir to combine and serve warm.

name: Batch Breakfast Burritos
instructions: 1. Cook bacon in a fry pan until crispy. Remove and crumble. 2. Saute diced peppers in pan. 3. Whisk eggs and add to pan scrambling until cooked through. 4. Add bacon back to pan and mix. 5. Warm tortillas and fill with egg mixture. Top with cheese and salsa.

name: Batch Seasonal Frittata
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 375F. 2. Heat olive oil in oven-safe pan. Saute diced peppers and spinach. 3. Whisk eggs with milk salt and pepper. Pour over vegetables. 4. Top with shredded cheese. 5. Bake 20-25 minutes until eggs are set and top is golden.

name: Greek-Style Garbanzo Bean Salad
ingredients: garbanzo beans,cucumber,cherry tomatoes,red onion,olive oil,lemon juice,salt,pepper
instructions: 1. Drain and rinse garbanzo beans. 2. Dice cucumber tomatoes and red onion. 3. Combine all vegetables and beans in a large bowl. 4. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice. 5. Season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Refrigerate 30 min before serving.

name: Ham and Pea Salad
ingredients: deli ham,frozen peas,shredded cheese,plain yogurt,apple cider vinegar,salt,pepper
instructions: 1. Thaw peas under cold water. 2. Dice ham. 3. Combine ham peas and cheese in a bowl. 4. Mix yogurt and vinegar together to make dressing. Season with salt and pepper. 5. Toss salad with dressing and refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: Tuna Salad with Garbanzo Beans
ingredients: canned tuna,garbanzo beans,celery,red onion,plain yogurt,lemon juice,salt,pepper
instructions: 1. Drain tuna and garbanzo beans. 2. Dice celery and red onion. 3. Combine tuna beans celery and onion in a bowl. 4. Add yogurt and lemon juice and mix well. 5. Season with salt and pepper. Serve on whole wheat bread or lettuce.

name: Cowboy Caviar
ingredients: black beans,corn,cherry tomatoes,bell pepper,red onion,cilantro,lime juice,olive oil,cumin,salt
instructions: 1. Drain and rinse black beans. 2. Drain corn. 3. Dice tomatoes peppers and onion. 4. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl. 5. Drizzle with olive oil and lime juice. 6. Add cumin cilantro and salt. Toss to combine. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving.

name: Pasta Salad
ingredients: pasta,bell pepper,cherry tomatoes,cucumber,shredded cheese,olive oil,apple cider vinegar,salt,pepper
instructions: 1. Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain and cool. 2. Dice all vegetables. 3. Combine cooled pasta vegetables and cheese in a large bowl. 4. Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar. 5. Season with salt and pepper and toss. Refrigerate 30 min before serving.

name: Seasonal Wraps
ingredients: whole wheat tortilla,chicken,lettuce,cherry tomatoes,shredded cheese,plain yogurt
instructions: 1. Cook chicken and slice thinly. 2. Warm tortillas. 3. Spread yogurt on tortilla. 4. Add lettuce tomatoes and sliced chicken. 5. Sprinkle with cheese. 6. Roll up tightly and slice in half to serve.

name: Zucchini Burger
ingredients: zucchini,egg,bread crumbs,shredded cheese,garlic powder,salt,pepper,whole wheat bun
instructions: 1. Grate zucchini and squeeze out excess water. 2. Combine zucchini egg bread crumbs cheese garlic powder salt and pepper. 3. Form into patties. 4. Cook in oiled pan over medium heat 4-5 min per side until golden. 5. Serve on whole wheat bun with desired toppings.

name: Chicken and Spinach Quesadilla
instructions: 1. Cook chicken and dice or shred. 2. Heat a fry pan over medium heat. 3. Place tortilla in pan. Add chicken spinach and cheese on one half. 4. Fold tortilla over and cook 2-3 min per side until golden and cheese melts. 5. Slice and serve with salsa.

name: Black Bean and Tomato Salad
instructions: 1. Drain and rinse black beans and corn. 2. Dice red onion. 3. Combine beans tomatoes corn and onion in a bowl. 4. Add lime juice cumin cilantro and salt. 5. Toss well and let marinate 30 minutes before serving.

name: Stuffed Sweet Potato
ingredients: sweet potato,black beans,shredded cheese,salsa,plain yogurt,cumin,chili powder
instructions: 1. Pierce sweet potatoes and microwave 10-12 min until soft. 2. Drain and season black beans with cumin and chili powder. 3. Split potatoes open. 4. Top with beans cheese salsa and a dollop of yogurt. 5. Serve immediately.

name: Rainbow Chicken
instructions: 1. Cook brown rice according to package directions. 2. Slice chicken and all vegetables into strips. 3. Heat olive oil in a fry pan over medium-high heat. 4. Cook chicken through then remove. 5. Saute onion garlic and carrots 3 min. Add peppers and cook 2 more min. 6. Return chicken to pan and season. 7. Serve over rice.

name: Kidney Bean and Corn Chili
ingredients: kidney beans,corn,stewed tomatoes,bell pepper,yellow onion,garlic,chili powder,cumin,salt
instructions: 1. Dice onion peppers and garlic. 2. Saute onion and peppers in pot over medium heat until soft. 3. Add garlic and cook 1 min. 4. Add drained beans corn and tomatoes. 5. Season with chili powder cumin and salt. 6. Simmer 20-30 minutes stirring occasionally. 7. Serve hot.

name: Sweet Potato and Sausage Soup
ingredients: sweet potato,turkey sausage,kale,yellow onion,garlic,chicken broth,olive oil,salt,pepper
instructions: 1. Remove sausage from casing and cook in large pot over medium heat until browned. Remove and set aside. 2. Saute diced onion and garlic in olive oil. 3. Add cubed sweet potato and broth. Bring to boil and simmer 10 min. 4. Add kale and sausage back to pot. 5. Cook 5 more minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Turkey Goulash
ingredients: ground turkey,pasta,stewed tomatoes,yellow onion,garlic,bell pepper,chili powder,salt,pepper
instructions: 1. Cook ground turkey in a large pot until browned. 2. Drain fat. 3. Add diced onion garlic and peppers. Cook until softened. 4. Add stewed tomatoes and chili powder. 5. Add pasta and enough water to cover. 6. Simmer 15-20 min until pasta is cooked. 7. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Yogurt Dip for Vegetables
instructions: 1. Combine yogurt dill garlic powder and salt in a bowl. 2. Stir well to combine. 3. Serve with sliced cucumber carrots and bell pepper for dipping.

name: Yogurt Dip and Fruit
instructions: 1. Combine yogurt and honey in a small bowl and stir well. 2. Wash and slice all fruit. 3. Arrange fruit on a plate and serve with yogurt dip.

name: Spiced Walnuts
instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350F. 2. Combine walnuts brown sugar cinnamon and salt in a bowl. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat. 4. Spread on a cookie sheet. 5. Bake 10-12 minutes until toasted and fragrant. 6. Cool completely before serving.

name: Seasonal Yogurts
instructions: 1. Scoop yogurt into bowls. 2. Top with desired seasonal fruits (berries in summer peaches in fall pears in winter). 3. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with nuts. 4. Serve immediately.

name: Microwave Fruit Crisp
instructions: 1. Peel and slice fruit and place in microwave-safe dish. 2. Combine oats brown sugar cinnamon and melted butter in a bowl and mix until crumbly. 3. Spread oat mixture over fruit. 4. Microwave on high 5-7 minutes until fruit is tender and topping is crispy. 5. Cool slightly before serving.

name: Ragi Adai (Finger Millet Dosa)
ingredients: ragi flour,fried gram,murungai spinach,grated coconut,green chillies,onion,grated carrot,salt
instructions: 1. Grind the fried gram into powder. Wash and clean the spinach. 2. Add spinach to ragi flour and mix in grated carrot green chillies chopped onion and salt. 3. Add water and mix to batter consistency. 4. Heat dosa pan spread a ladle full of batter. 5. Once cooked flip and cook again. Transfer to plate. 6. Serve with coconut chutney.

name: Kambu Kozhukattai (Pearl Millet Dumplings)
instructions: 1. Wash kambu groundnut roasted grams and boiled rice and roast them in a pan until golden brown. 2. Grind the mixture to flour. 3. Add chopped coconut and cardamom powder to the flour. 4. Melt jaggery in boiling water and filter it. 5. Add jaggery mix to flour and prepare dough. 6. Shape dough into small round dumplings. 7. Cook them in idly maker and serve hot.

name: Corn and Gram Flour Roti
instructions: 1. Roast corn flour and gram flour separately in a pan then mix together. 2. Add washed drumstick leaves chopped onion salt and water to the mix. 3. Knead to chapati consistency. 4. Split dough into small balls and roll to small rotis. 5. Cook on hot tava with little oil flipping to cook both sides. 6. Serve hot.

name: Saamai Tamarind Pongal (Little Millet Pongal)
ingredients: saamai millet,raw groundnut,shallots,red chilli,mustard,sambar powder,jaggery,sesame oil,tamarind,salt
instructions: 1. Soak tamarind and extract two cups of tamarind extract. 2. Pour gingelly oil in hot pressure pan and add sesame curry leaves fenugreek and dry chillies and shallots. 3. Add tamarind extract millet jaggery sambar powder groundnut salt and a cup of water. 4. Close with lid and steam till one whistle. 5. Serve hot with chopped onions.

name: Millet Kozhukattai (Barnyard Millet Dumplings)
instructions: 1. Grind kuthiraivali rice to flour. 2. Add mustard black gram cumin curry leaves to hot oil in a pan and saute. 3. Add chopped green chillies salt grated coconut and a cup of water. 4. Once cooked add millet flour and mix well until pliable dough forms. 5. Shape into neat dough balls and place in a vessel. 6. Steam for 7 minutes and serve with coconut chutney.

name: Kambu Palak Roti (Pearl Millet Spinach Flatbread)
instructions: 1. Chop palak spinach and keep aside. 2. Add oil to pearl millet flour along with a pinch of salt chopped spinach and knead to chapatti dough consistency. 3. Shape dough into small balls and roll into rotis with a rolling pin. 4. Cook on hot tava flipping to cook both sides with little ghee. 5. Serve hot.

name: Varagu Tomato Rice (Kodo Millet Tomato Rice)
ingredients: varagu millet,tomato,onion,chilli powder,coriander powder,turmeric powder,tamarind,ginger,garlic,oil,coriander leaves,green chilli,cinnamon
instructions: 1. Clean varagu and keep aside. 2. In a hot pan add oil and saute mustard urad dal ginger garlic paste chopped onion and tomato. 3. Add turmeric powder coriander powder chilli powder and tamarind. 4. Add required water and salt and allow to boil. 5. Add varagu rice and let it cook. 6. Serve hot.

name: Millet Puttu (Mixed Millet Steamed Cake)
instructions: 1. Grind all the grains and mix them thoroughly. 2. Steam the mix until it is cooked. 3. Add grated coconut and jaggery and serve warm.

name: Millet Veg Biryani
ingredients: kuthiraivali millet,green peas,carrot,beans,ginger,bay leaf,cinnamon,ghee,tomato,garlic,onion,green chilli,coriander,pudina,curry leaves,lemon,fennel seeds,cumin
instructions: 1. Grind ginger cinnamon onion and garlic into a paste. 2. Heat ghee in a cooker and saute cinnamon bay leaf fennel seeds cumin curry leaves pudina and coriander. 3. Add the ground paste and cook until raw smell leaves. 4. Add chopped tomato onion green chillies vegetables peas and saute well. 5. Add millet rice and enough water and steam. 6. Serve hot with raita.

name: Kambu Paniyaram (Pearl Millet Sweet Dumplings)
ingredients: kambu flour,raw rice,black gram,jaggery,cardamom,cashew nut,fenugreek seeds,oil
instructions: 1. Soak kambu raw rice black gram and fenugreek seeds in water for 12 hours. 2. Drain and grind to a paste. 3. Add salt. 4. Boil water and add jaggery. Let it boil until jaggery melts. Filter and pour into dough. 5. Add cardamom and cashew nuts. 6. In a hot paniyaram pan apply oil and pour batter. Cover and steam then flip and cook until done. 7. Serve hot.

name: Kuthiraivali Veg Biryani (Barnyard Millet Biryani)
ingredients: kuthiraivali millet,green peas,carrot,beans,ghee,oil,cashew nut,ginger garlic paste,turmeric,curry masala powder,tomato,green chilli,dry chilli,cardamom,pudina,salt
instructions: 1. Pour oil or ghee in a broad vessel. Saute cardamom and cashew nuts. 2. Add ginger garlic paste and saute until raw smell leaves. 3. Add all chopped vegetables one after another and saute. 4. Add curry masala powder turmeric and half litre water. Let it boil. 5. Add kuthiraivali rice and steam well. 6. Serve hot.

name: Corn Paniyaram (Corn Dumplings)
instructions: 1. Mix corn flour with grated coconut jaggery and cardamom. 2. Add enough water to make a thick batter. 3. Heat paniyaram pan and add oil to each mould. 4. Pour batter into moulds. 5. Cover and cook then flip to cook other side until golden. 6. Serve hot.

name: Peanut Sundal (Boiled Peanuts Salad)
ingredients: raw peanuts,onion,green chilli,lemon juice,coriander leaves,salt,mustard seeds,curry leaves,oil
instructions: 1. Boil peanuts in salted water until soft. Drain. 2. Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds curry leaves and green chilli. 3. Add boiled peanuts and toss. 4. Add diced onion coriander leaves and lemon juice. 5. Mix well and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Vegetable Upma
instructions: 1. Dry roast semolina until lightly golden. Set aside. 2. Heat oil in pan and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. 3. Add chopped onion green chilli and vegetables. Saute until soft. 4. Add 2 cups water and salt. Bring to boil. 5. Add roasted semolina gradually stirring continuously. 6. Cook until water is absorbed and upma is fluffy. 7. Serve hot.

name: Vegetable Khichdi
instructions: 1. Wash rice and moong dal together. 2. Heat ghee in pressure cooker and add cumin seeds. 3. Add chopped onion and saute until translucent. 4. Add carrots peas and saute 2 minutes. 5. Add rice and dal and mix well. 6. Add turmeric salt and 3 cups water. 7. Pressure cook for 2-3 whistles. 8. Serve hot with yogurt or pickle.

name: Banana Oats Porridge
instructions: 1. Cook oats in coconut milk adding extra water if needed until thick and creamy. 2. Mash banana and add to oats. 3. Add grated jaggery and cardamom. 4. Stir well until jaggery melts. 5. Serve warm. Can be served to children as a nutritious first food.

name: Sprouted Moong Salad
instructions: 1. Sprout moong beans by soaking overnight then letting sit in damp cloth for 24 hours. 2. Blanch sprouts in hot water for 2 minutes. Drain and cool. 3. Dice tomato cucumber and onion. 4. Combine all ingredients in a bowl. 5. Add lemon juice salt pepper and coriander leaves. 6. Toss well and serve fresh.

name: Ragi (Finger Millet) Porridge
instructions: 1. Mix ragi flour with water to make a smooth paste without lumps. 2. Boil 2 cups water in a pan. 3. Slowly add ragi paste to boiling water stirring continuously. 4. Cook on low heat for 5-7 minutes until thick. 5. Add jaggery and stir until melted. 6. Add grated coconut and cardamom. 7. Serve warm. Excellent for children and pregnant women.

name: Green Pea and Carrot Stir Fry
instructions: 1. Heat oil in pan and add mustard seeds. 2. Once they splutter add curry leaves and garlic. 3. Add diced onion and saute until soft. 4. Add sliced carrots and cook 3-4 minutes. 5. Add peas turmeric and salt. 6. Cover and cook 5 more minutes until vegetables are tender. 7. Serve as a side dish with rice or roti.

name: Sesame Ladoo (Sesame Seed Balls)
instructions: 1. Dry roast sesame seeds in a pan on low heat until golden and fragrant. Cool slightly. 2. Melt jaggery with a few tablespoons of water to make a thick syrup. 3. Mix sesame seeds and cardamom into jaggery syrup. 4. Grease palms with ghee and shape mixture into small balls while still warm. 5. Cool completely before serving.

name: Tomato Rasam (South Indian Tomato Soup)
instructions: 1. Soak tamarind and extract juice. 2. Crush garlic and grind cumin and pepper to coarse powder. 3. Heat oil in pan add mustard seeds curry leaves and garlic. 4. Add tomatoes and saute until mushy. 5. Add tamarind extract turmeric and pepper-cumin powder. 6. Bring to boil and simmer 10 minutes. 7. Add salt and garnish with coriander leaves. 8. Serve hot with rice.
